scenario: A TIME-DEPENDENT CONDITION replayed ([LFST.9.1], [LTIM.2.5.1]). `held` fires once a Ping has been live 3_s, reading `dwell` on the monotonic clock and re-evaluated by the tick. Ping a at 0, Ping b at 2_s, pumps at 4_s and 6_s: a crosses at the 4_s pump and b at the 6_s one, with no input in either pump, so the only thing that makes them fire is the clock the replay was given. Paths: libds records through `rfcs/codec.c`'s recorder and replays through `ds_rfcs_replay_*` (pyds `Engine.record` / `Engine.replay`), which byte-compares each re-derived RuleFireAnnotation and FactEmit; the Mercury runtime records through `ds.rfcs` and replays through `ds.replay`.
rules_ds:
schema Ping scope logical:
    k: String key

schema Held scope ttl 1_h:
    k: String

rule held:
    Ping p where p.dwell >= 3_s
->
    emit Held k: p.k
